subject: literacy
concept: Reading a longer passage and applying text-structure, character-motivation, and summarizing skills together
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student follows along with pictures while reading a longer passage
exercise.abstract: Student reads a full passage, identifies its structure and purpose, and writes a short summary

assessment.mastery_threshold: correctly identifies structure/purpose and produces an adequate summary
misconception_flags: identifies structure correctly but summary is inaccurate or overly long

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
